channel.title: Wooden Spoon Journal
channel.description: Ice cream guides and flavour notes from Wooden Spoon Boutique Freezery

item.title: How to Make an Ice Cream Cake at Home
item.description: A no-bake ice cream cake recipe: biscuit base, layered ice cream, a crunchy middle and whipped cream on top, plus timings, tins, slicing tips and swaps.

item.title: How to Plan an Office Ice Cream Party
item.description: Plan a stress-free office ice cream party: how much to order, freezer space, dietary needs, serving kit, timing and a printable checklist for the organiser.

item.title: What Makes Small-Batch Ice Cream Different?
item.description: Small-batch vs mass-made ice cream: cooked bases, air (overrun), fat and solids, house-made mix-ins, and how to spot a quality tub on the shelf.

item.title: How to Make Affogato at Home (Coffee + Ice Cream)
item.description: Affogato is a scoop of ice cream drowned in hot espresso. How to make it with a machine, plunger or moka pot, the best flavours to use, and grown-up twists.

item.title: How to Keep Ice Cream Frozen on the Way Home
item.description: Chilly bins, ice packs, insulated bags and dry ice: how to get ice cream home or to a picnic without melting, how long it lasts, and dry ice safety rules.

item.title: Wooden Ice Cream Spoons: Better Than Plastic?
item.description: Why wooden ice cream spoons replaced plastic in New Zealand, how they compare with compostable and metal options, and how to dispose of them properly.

item.title: Ice Cream Allergens: Milk, Gluten, Egg, Nuts and Soy
item.description: Which allergens hide in ice cream, how New Zealand allergen labelling works since 2024, cross-contact risks, and questions to ask before buying a scoop.

item.title: How to Make Ice Cream Sandwiches at Home
item.description: Step-by-step ice cream sandwiches: the best cookies for freezing, how thick to make the filling, the press-and-freeze method, flavour pairings and storage.

item.title: Hokey Pokey Ice Cream: NZ's Favourite Flavour Explained
item.description: What hokey pokey is, where New Zealand's classic ice cream flavour came from, how the honeycomb toffee works, and how to make crunchy hokey pokey at home.

item.title: How Much Ice Cream Do You Need for a Party?
item.description: A simple guide to party ice cream quantities: millilitres per person, a table for 10 to 100 guests, kids vs adults, flavours to pick and how to keep it frozen.

item.title: Gelato vs Ice Cream vs Frozen Custard: The Differences
item.description: Gelato, ice cream and frozen custard compared: fat, air, eggs, serving temperature and texture, plus what New Zealand food rules say ice cream must contain.

item.title: Dairy-Free Ice Cream Explained: Oat, Coconut or Cashew?
item.description: What dairy-free ice cream is made from, how oat, coconut and cashew bases compare for texture and allergens, and what to check if you're vegan or coeliac.

item.title: How to Soften Ice Cream for Perfect Scoops
item.description: Rock-hard tub? Soften ice cream the right way: fridge and bench timings, the warm-scoop trick, why not to microwave it, and how to scoop without bending spoons.

item.title: How to Store Ice Cream at Home and Stop Freezer Burn
item.description: Keep ice cream creamy for longer: the right freezer temperature, where to put the tub, how to stop ice crystals and freezer burn, and how long it lasts.
